NONE: › informal for megabyte: used when talking about how much information a computer can store
（電腦）百萬位元組（電腦儲存容量單位元）
› very good or very big
非常好的；巨大的
› science 1,000,000 times the stated unit
兆，百萬倍
› informal large in amount or size
非常多的；巨大的
› a very large amount of money
大筆的錢

example: 他們兩人掙的錢都非常多。

NONE: › a unit used in measuring the amount of information a computer can store, with the value 1,048,576 bytes
百萬位元組（電腦儲存單位，相當於1 048 576位元組）
› a very large city, especially one with more than 10 million people living in it
巨型城市（人口超過一千萬的城市）
› a million hertz
兆赫
› a large stone, sometimes forming part of a group or circle, thought to have been important to people in the Stone Age for social or religious reasons
巨石
› an unnaturally strong wish for power and control, or the belief that you are very much more important and powerful than you really are
誇大狂，自大狂；妄自尊大
› a cone-shaped device that makes your voice louder when you speak into it, so that people can hear you although they are not near to you
喇叭，話筒，擴音器
› one million pixels (= small points that form part of the image on a computer screen), used to measure the amount of detail in images made by a digital camera, computer screen, etc.
百萬畫素（電腦、數位相機解析度單位）
› a very large cinema where a lot of films are shown at the same time
（可同時放映多部電影的）大型影城

example: 設有12個放映廳的大型影城

NONE: › a very famous person, especially an actor or pop star
大名人；（尤指）超級明星，流行巨星
› a very large shop
大商店，大商場
› a unit that has the same value as the force produced by 1,000,000 tons of TNT (= an explosive), used for measuring the power of explosions, especially nuclear explosions
百萬噸級（相當於100萬噸黃色炸藥的爆炸威力，用於計量爆炸威力、尤其是核武器的爆炸威力）
› a unit for measuring electric power, with the value of 1,000,000 watts
兆瓦，百萬瓦特
